title: First Voyage
description: SwiftCargo needs a new dispatcher account. Register a user, then log in with those credentials and confirm the API hands back a valid access token.
successCondition: POST /api/auth/register followed by POST /api/auth/login both return 2xx with a user object and a non-empty accessToken.
hints: Registration and login both live under /api/auth.
The response body shape is documented in docs/api/auth.md.
